title: Solutions Architect
description: About Zelara Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way. Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome. With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. We are growing our Solutions Architecture team to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable across more customers. The Role This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not reactive customer success, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature. You own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption. You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair. They own pricing, contracts, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and the evidence behind those decisions: before signature you lead technical discovery alongside them, after signature you are the customer's named technical lead for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, and go-live. There is no separate customer success manager; the two of you hold the whole relationship.

title: Change Management Consultant
description:
About ttcInnovations
Founded in 2001, ttcInnovations is a certified woman-owned consulting and talent partner supporting Fortune 500 organizations. We connect clients with top-tier experts through staff augmentation, project delivery, and flexible engagement models, always prioritizing culture fit and impact.
Today, we’re evolving alongside traditional learning services into a business transformation and performance partner. Our work is increasingly focused on diagnostic-led engagements that drive measurable outcomes across performance consulting, change management, enablement, and sustainment.
This posting is for future opportunities. We are creating a talent pool to support upcoming client engagements as needs emerge.

Engagement Type: Contract / Project‑Based
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Start Date: Based on project availability
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Change Management Consultant to support clients through complex transformation initiatives. This role embeds structured change management strategies into learning and enablement solutions, ensuring initiatives drive adoption, reduce resistance, and accelerate measurable business outcomes.
The consultant operates in a client‑facing, advisory capacity and partners closely with business leaders, HR, L&D, and internal design teams to integrate change strategy with learning and execution.
Key Responsibilities

• Partner with client stakeholders to assess change readiness, organizational impact, and adoption risk.

• Develop and apply change management strategies aligned to business initiatives and transformation goals.

• Provide subject matter expertise across core change domains, including:

•

• Stakeholder identification and engagement

• Communication planning and messaging alignment

• Change adoption and reinforcement strategies

• Resistance identification and management

• Collaborate with instructional designers to align learning solutions with broader change journeys.

• Support the development of change enablement assets, including:

•

• Change communication plans

• Manager toolkits and leader enablement resources

• Adoption and sustainment strategies

• Facilitate workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and leadership meetings as needed.

• Define and track success metrics related to change adoption, behavior change, and engagement.

• Incorporate feedback and performance data to continuously improve change and learning solutions.

Required Experience

• 8+ years of experience in change management, organizational development, or transformation roles.

• Hands‑on experience leading or supporting enterprise or large‑scale change initiatives.

• Strong working knowledge of change frameworks (e.g., Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter).

• Experience partnering cross‑functionally with business, HR, and L&D leaders.

• Comfortable operating in client‑facing, project‑based environments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prosci or similar change management certification.

• Experience supporting large‑scale technology, process, or organizational transformations.

• Consulting, advisory, or professional services experience.

What Success Looks Like

• Recommended solutions are embedded within a clear, structured change approach.

• Clients experience stronger adoption, reduced resistance, and faster realization of benefits.

• Stakeholders view you as a trusted change advisor, not just a framework expert.

• Change efforts result in observable behavior change tied to business outcomes.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Test Engineer Teams

We’re seeking an exceptional Test Engineer to join our Germany-based team focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Test Engineer, you'll independently own the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack. You'll build robust, reusable test automation, drive failures to root cause across engineering boundaries, and steadily raise the bar on coverage, reliability, and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system including sensing and model-behaviour testing as the company and your experience evolve. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement across multiple engineering domains.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration, and system levels, across software and hardware boundaries.

- Automate open-loop and closed-loop replay based Tests, reliability and fault-injection tests to support verification, release, coverage expansion, and debug workflows.

- Lead root-cause investigations for failures found during test campaigns, collaborating across hardware, software, and infrastructure teams.

- Optimise buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable, and repeatable execution.

- Integrate third-party verification tools including JAMA (requirements), MC/DC (coverage), and MISRA (style compliance); manage artefacts via Artifactory and Azure.

- Define and track KPIs and quality metrics for system testing, supporting data-driven validation and release decisions.

- Uncover software and hardware bugs through increased test coverage and report findings through JIRA.

- Identify and implement infrastructure improvements that enhance test coverage, failure traceability, and compliance reporting.

- Review, create, and adhere to Risk Assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

 

🙌 You should apply if

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software, or mechatronic systems, with a track record of delivering test automation independently.

- Experience with L2+ hands-off, L3, or L4 automated driving systems.

- Knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols (e.g., Euro NCAP -AEB, LSS/LKA, ADAS scenarios), DCAS regulatory testing (UN R171), and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155).

- Experience with HiL testing and tooling using CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, dSPACE, Vector, Xylon, or similar.

- Strong proficiency in Python, including developing automation test frameworks with pytest.

- Proven ability in interface-level testing, including hardware/software interactions and embedded interfaces.

- Experience integrating software quality assurance tools and standards (ASPICE, SOTIF, ISO 26262, JAMA, X-RAY).

- Knowledge of open- and closed-loop HiL replay using dSPACE or other emulators.

- Proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling (e.g., GitLab CI, Buildkite, Bazel).

- Experience with test automation dashboards, logging, and reporting infrastructure (e.g., Grafana, Looker, Datadog, JIRA).

- Experience developing or testing automotive software across embedded and system levels.

- Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work collaboratively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps, and product teams.

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection & Response)
description:
About Point

✨ Real Impact, Real People: Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

✨ Funding: With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we’re scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

✨ Game-changing Product: We're building a category defining company in home equity. We’ve earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

✨ Great Place to Work: Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection: Work from anywhere in the U.S., while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture.

Local or 100% Remote

About the role
Point Digital Finance is expanding its Information Security function, and this is the team's first dedicated monitoring and response hire - a high-visibility role with immediate, measurable impact. As Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection & Response), you will be the second half of an incident-response rotation, partnering directly with the security lead to detect, investigate, and contain threats across a regulated consumer-finance environment that protects the financial data of hundreds of thousands of homeowners. This is not an alert-watching seat: you will engineer the detections, automate the response, and harden how we see our AWS, Google Workspace, and SaaS estate. You'll help stand up a modern detection & response practice from an early-stage footing, with the autonomy to own problems end to end and the mandate to turn noisy alerts into fast, repeatable, well-documented response. If you like building as much as responding - and want your work to directly reduce risk to real people's financial lives - this role is for you.
Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team!
Your responsibilities

• Rotate on-call and lead response: share the 24/7 on-call and incident-response rotation with the security lead - triaging, investigating, and driving containment of security alerts and incidents.

• Own response documentation: build and maintain incident-response runbooks, escalation paths, and post-incident reviews so response is consistent and repeatable.

• Engineer detections: build, tune, and maintain SIEM detections, correlation rules, dashboards, and reporting in Coralogix across cloud and identity log sources.

• Close coverage gaps: reduce false positives and onboard new log sources to eliminate detection blind spots.

• Own vulnerability management: run day-to-day vulnerability management - prioritize findings, coordinate remediation with system owners, and report on risk reduction across cloud and endpoints.

• Automate response: develop detection-as-code and lightweight automation/SOAR so common alerts self-triage and response is faster and repeatable.

• Add operational redundancy: serve as a redundant administrative and response path so containment is never bottlenecked on a single person.

• Report and evidence: produce recurring security metrics and reporting for leadership, and supply control evidence for audits.

• Apply AI to the workflow: use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate investigation, correlation, and detection engineering.

• Improve the program: contribute to continuous improvement of the security-operations program, tooling, and threat monitoring.

About you

• 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, SOC, or detection engineering (mid-to-senior individual contributor).

• Hands-on experience running or actively participating in an on-call / incident-response rotation, independently.

• Strong SIEM skills - authoring and tuni

• Create and develop original concepts of characters, environment, and props based on references or from scratch.

• Attend weekly meetings with the whole team on Slack (instant messaging software we use for communication).

• Present concepts and ideas to the team for further discussion.

• Creatively problem-solve and figure out efficient solutions to executing the look and feel of the character and environment.

• Achieve a balance between artistic aspects and technical constraints.

• Adjust the artwork styles to meet the game’s art direction.

• Set your own reasonable deadlines, and make sure the work is done on time.

Minimum Requirements:

• Working knowledge of design and drawing programs such as photoshop, illustrator, procreate, or your program of choice.

• Excellent understanding of art fundamentals: lighting, composition, architecture, human anatomy, etc.

• Ability to create high-quality concept art and illustrations of characters, creatures, environments, architecture, and more.

• Ability to give and take feedback professionally and applies it to the art and design.

• Flexibility and adaptive capabilities. Able to collaborate and work as a part of the team.

• Fluency in English is a must.

• Experience in game design or game developing industry.

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Software Engineer, Payments Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The agent must collect and use a card number but can never see it. This work sits across four hard technical domains: payments, security, real-time voice, and LLMs. Voice is the core challenge. A caller speaks or types a card number in a live, low-latency audio stream, and the digits must never reach the model, while the model stays on the call.

Sierra owns every system that touches card data, and one small team owns it end to end across three workstreams: Platform, Product, and Safety & Integrity. Customers keep their own telephony and payment gateways. Payments is live in production for some of the largest consumer enterprises, on a platform that handles hundreds of millions of calls a year. The platform is certified to PCI DSS Level 1.

- Build real-time card capture for voice: intercept keypad and spoken digits in a live audio stream, upstream of the agent runtime in a network-segmented environment, while the LLM stays live on the call. Make it work across every telephony provider and protocol Sierra supports.

- Build and extend the tokenization platform: agents receive and send short-lived tokens, and the platform swaps a token for the real value only when it calls the customer's payment gateway.

- Own the payments egress control plane: every destination for card data is approved, versioned with the agent release, and enforced by infrastructure below the application, not by convention.

- Make payment actions correct: an at-most-once action primitive in the Agent SDK, validated amounts and items, and monitoring that compares what the agent said about a payment with what really happened.

- Keep card data out of places it should not be: deterministic detection in the agent's hot path that catches what general-purpose models miss. No LLM, including any we build ourselves, ever sees a plaintext card number.

- Make payments self-serve: one payments API across Agent Studio, the Agent SDK, and Ghostwriter, Sierra's agent-building agent; gateway middleware that developers write against tokens; and support for single-tenant and customer-cloud deployments. Any team can add payments to an agent without a payments engineer in the loop.

- Grow the platform beyond cards: extend tokenization into a privacy vault for all PII.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years building backend, platform, or infrastructure systems, with a track record of shipping and operating high-reliability services in production.

- A deep security instinct. You design as though every component will eventually be compromised, and you reason naturally about blast radius, least privilege, and making bad states impossible rather than reacting to them.

- Rigor abo

title: Sr. Customer Engineer
locationText: Raleigh, NC / New York City, NY
description:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Customer Engineering team is the technical backbone of the pre- and post-sales customer motion. The team brings together work that has historically sat across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo.

As a Senior Customer Engineer, you own strategic and complex Enterprise accounts across acquisition, implementation, adoption, expansion, and escalation. You lead technical strategy for complex deployments, resolve ambiguous customer challenges, and partner closely with account teams to drive retention, expansion, and customer value. Your impact extends beyond your own accounts through playbooks, coaching, repeatable fixes, and workflow improvements that raise the capability of the broader Customer Engineering team.

This is a remote role supporting an East Coast territory. 

What this looks like day-to-day

• New customer acquisition and selling: Partner with Account Directors on pre-sales motions for new customer acquisition, product expansion, and expansion across lines of business. You identify customer pain, craft and deliver tailored demos, and lead technical evaluations through requirements gathering, success criteria, installation guidance, and hands-on workshops.

• Complex implementations and value realization: Lead onboarding for strategic customers, including planning, implementation, integrations, and training. You build customer-specific implementation playbooks, guide complex deployments with executive visibility, and ensure customers realize value during onboarding and over time.

• Adoption, expansion, and growth: Identify opportunities to expand adoption across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, you diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.

• Technical escalation: Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges raised by other Customer Engineers. You resolve ambiguous problems with multiple variables and tradeoffs, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.

• Team capability building: Build playbooks, document repeatable fixes, coach peers, and improve how Customer Engineering work gets done across the team. You use AI tools to accelerate content creation, surface patterns across accounts, and share practical workflow findings with the broader team.

• Early account impact: Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. You establish trust with Account Directors and customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.

• Quarterly business outcomes: Drive measurable improvement in customer health, retention, expansion, and technical resolution across strategic accounts. You contribute reusable frameworks, playbooks, or processes that other Customer Engineers use and become a trusted advisor to Account Directors on account health and technical strategy.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Customer Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

description:
MOFGA Certification Services, LLC (MCS) is hiring a full time Organic Certification Specialist (Livestock/Dairy focused) to join our team. The Certification Specialist provides high quality customer service along with skilled review and auditing verification to support positive organic certification experiences for organic producers in our service territory, while upholding the USDA National Organic Program regulations. The ideal candidate will have education and experience in organic regulations, organic and/or sustainable farming methods and production, and familiarity with the various production scopes that MCS certifies. Experience in food processing is a plus. The Certification Specialist reports to the MCS Director and works collaboratively with MCS staff, specialists, and inspectors. This position assesses compliance of an operation’s organic system plan, reviews inspection reports, and issues subsequent responses, primarily within the livestock and dairy scopes. Employees receive a generous paid time off package, including vacation and sick time, three personal days, two week-long office closures, 14 paid holidays annually, and a sabbatical after seven years of employment.
Location: This position is remote, requiring travel within MCS’ service territory, and off-site visits to client’s farms and production facilities. The service territory includes the state of Maine, the state of New Hampshire, and the northeastern areas of Massachusetts. Our offices are located in Unity, Maine and staff are welcome to work from this office as much as they like. title: Security Engineer Internship
description:
Security Engineer
Overview: Supply Chain Security and Compliance
The Security Engineer is a critical role responsible for implementing and enforcing robust security practices across our entire integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will safeguard e-commerce transactions, secure internal tool integrations, and establish the trust framework for our AI agent operations, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards like PCI-DSS and GDPR.
Internship Details

• Duration: 3 months (extendable based on performance and project scope)

• Start Date: Immediate

• Location: Remote

• Stipend: Unpaid initially; may convert to a paid internship, full-time role, or even direct client absorption (FTE) based on your performance

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will secure all layers of the application, from the Next.js frontend to the NestJS modular monolith and the cloud infrastructure.

• Security Architecture & Threat Modeling: Perform vulnerability assessments, code reviews, and threat modeling for all new features and systems, focusing on the critical MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS business process flow.

• Compliance Enforcement: Lead the implementation and auditing of security controls necessary for PCI-DSS compliance (for Payment module) and GDPR compliance (for user/tenant data handling).

• Access Control & Authentication: Implement and manage secure API authentication methods, including OAuth 2.0 and SAML, utilizing Authentik/Ory Kratos and leveraging PostgreSQL's Row-Level Security (RLS) for tenant isolation.

• Secrets & Encryption: Manage secrets and key rotation using Vault, define and enforce encryption protocols for data both in transit and at rest, and manage certificates via Traefik.

• Abuse Prevention: Implement and monitor controls for API rate limiting, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, and traffic monitoring to prevent abuse and denial-of-service attacks.

• Incident Response: Develop and practice incident investigation and response protocols. Conduct security awareness training for development and operations teams.

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess hands-on security experience with our core stack and compliance tools:

• Platform Security: Node.js/NestJS security best practices, Next.js/React security, PostgreSQL RLS.

• Compliance Focus: Experience with PCI-DSS and GDPR controls and auditing.

• Authentication & Access: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT, Authentik/Ory Kratos.

• Secrets & Infrastructure: HashiCorp Vault, Docker, Terraform.

• Monitoring & Assessment: Tools for Static/Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST).

AI Agent Security
You will be responsible for securing the emerging AI ecosystem.

• Agent Trust Framework: Establish security boundaries for the AI agent interfaces, ensuring agents (built with LangChain/AutoGen) operate within strict permissions when accessing supply chain data (WMS, OMS).

• Prompt Injection Prevention: Implement validation and sanitization techniques to mitigate prompt injection and data exfiltration risks in user-facing LLM interactions.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Security Scorecard: Reduction in identified vulnerabilities from assessments and code reviews (SAST/DAST).

• Compliance Audits: Successful passing of regular PCI-DSS and GDPR audits.

• Incident Handling: Speed and effectiveness of security incident investigation and remediation.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, working closely with the development and DevOps teams to embed security into the CI/CD pipeline.

title: Co-Op, Electron Microscopy
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is seeking a Co-Op, Electron Microscopy to join the Materials Science team within the Autonomous Science Platform. This co-op supports advanced SEM characterization workflows across powdered materials and thin films, working alongside synthesis, characterization, and ML scientists to turn physical experiments into high-quality data.

The work is hands-on and instrument-heavy: acquiring imaging and compositional data, refining methods, and iterating on protocols that feed Lila's materials discovery platform. It suits a PhD student who wants depth in microstructural analysis and sees how characterization data drives AI-guided materials research.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and execute SEM-based characterization workflows across diverse chemistries and form factors

• Operate electron microscopy instrumentation under the guidance of staff scientists

• Partner with experimental scientists and engineers to optimize protocols and inform downstream analysis

• Troubleshoot instrumentation and workflow issues that affect data quality

• Capture imaging and analysis results in clear, reusable laboratory records

• Follow safety and compliance standards for instrument and sample handling

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently enrolled in a PhD in Materials Science, Physics, or a related field

• Strong background in SEM-based microstructural analysis

• Hands-on expertise with EDS, EBSD, and FIB (focused ion beam)

• Experience characterizing powdered materials and thin films

• Demonstrated ability to operate and troubleshoot advanced SEM systems

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Bonus Points For

• Experience with image analysis tools such as ImageJ or Python-based pipelines

• Familiarity with complementary techniques such as XRD or XRF

• Interest in automation and integration of microscopy with AI workflows

• Prior work characterizing nanoscale defects and interfaces

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

title: GTM Strategist

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

You'll own strategic outbound into a curated list of high-value targets, building account plans, identifying the right entry points, and running multi-threaded outreach that reflects genuine understanding of a business.

- Drive outbound into a named list of enterprise targets: researching organizations, mapping stakeholders, and running sequenced outreach that goes well beyond a cold email

- A track record of exceeding outbound activity and pipeline targets

- Demonstrated ability to research and build conviction on a company from the outside in

- Relentless drive and a bias toward action- you find a way through, not around

- Exceptional written and verbal communication; you craft outreach that earns a response and can move someone from cold to convinced

- High personal accountability and the ability to manage a complex workload without losing attention to detail

- Bachelor's degree from a top-tier university with strong academic performance in a rigorous field of study

Nice to Have

- Experience building target lists, executing outreach campaigns, and tracking pipeline independently

- Hands-on experience with outbound tooling such as Apollo, Clay, Outreach, or similar

- Familiarity with enterprise software, developer tooling, or the AI landscape

title: Co-Op, SCADA Engineer
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's SCADA system spans cloud and on-premise infrastructure: Ignition gateways on EC2, a historian on RDS PostgreSQL, MQTT brokers, and edge nodes at each site. Today no single view shows the health of all of it, so the team learns about failures from users rather than from monitoring.

As a co-op on the Hardware & Controls Engineering team, you will build that view: a live connectivity diagram showing how every piece connects and which links are up, backed by dashboards covering database, gateway, and edge node health. The work is read-only end to end, with read-only AWS access and SELECT-only database access, so you can explore the full system safely.

You will be based at our Alewife site in Cambridge, working alongside controls engineers and the IT/OT team. Expect wide exposure across AWS, Linux, industrial networking, Ignition, and data visualization, and a clear picture of how an industrial SCADA system fits together end to end.

What You'll Be Building

• Build a live topology view of edge nodes, brokers, gateways, and databases with per-link status and last-seen timestamps

• Surface RDS PostgreSQL health: CPU, memory, storage growth, connection counts, replication lag, and slow queries

• Dashboard Ignition gateway and EC2 metrics, including JVM heap, tag quality, Sparkplug birth and death rates, and scan timing

• Monitor on-premise edge nodes for reachability, uptime, resource use, and last publish time

• Integrate existing sources (CloudWatch, Performance Insights, Ignition gateway metrics, broker status) into one interface

• Document the setup so the team can extend and maintain it after the term ends

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field

• Available full time for the Spring 2027 co-op term, on-site at Alewife

• Proficiency in Python for scripting and data collection

• Comfortable working in Linux from the command line

• Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: IP addressing, subnets, ports, and routing

• Clear written communication for documenting dashboards and findings

Bonus Points For

• Exposure to AWS, particularly EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, or IAM

• Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, or similar observability tooling

• Familiarity with Ignition, MQTT or Sparkplug, or other industrial SCADA tooling

• JavaScript or React, useful for building inside Ignition Perspective

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

ABOUT THE ROLE

Darkroom is hiring a Cash Flow Analyst to join the Finance team. You’ll own billing, collections, accounts payable, creator payments, and cash visibility across more than 80 client accounts and around 100 invoices a month. You’ll report to the SVP of Finance and work closely with the Finance Operations Manager, who sets our collections strategy, as well as our account leads and external bookkeeper.

- Keep the weekly cash forecast current, with expected receipts by client and by week.

- Run accounts payable in Ramp: enter vendor bills, check them against approvals and contracts, schedule payments, and keep vendor records current.

- Pay creators, partners, and referral payouts in Ramp once amounts are approved, and keep payee records current.

description:
About the Role:
At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space-where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse.
What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities):

• 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space.

• Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces-distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle.

• Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality.

• Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one.

• Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning.

Qualification path
What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications):

• Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields).

• Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly.

• English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines.

• Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"-the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects.

Assessment:
In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour
Our Payment terms are defined for each project.

Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

description:
About Distru
Distru is the #1 ERP in the cannabis industry with $15B in sales processed through our platform. We've built a battle-tested ERP and B2B eCommerce platform that powers inventory, manufacturing, sales, and logistics, and we're now building AI infrastructure on top of it to give commercial businesses their all-in-one AI stack.
We're growing and profitable, with 5/5 stars on Glassdoor. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Poseidon Asset Management, and Village Global, who have funded companies such as Shopify, Cruise, HelloFresh, Facebook, Slack, and Opendoor.
Get to know the team, our culture and our full benefits at distru.com/careers!
The Role
AI is at an inflection point for enterprise use, and AI assistants like Claude, Codex, and Grok are seeing record adoption at work. We believe the system of record has never been more valuable for organizing the data AI acts on.
We started with our AI Order Agent, now rolled out across our customer base, which lets buyers submit orders from any source in any format. It's the first piece of a much bigger agentic ecosystem we’re building, and we're moving most of our engineering effort to AI-first work to build it.
You'll work directly with our Director of AI Engineering to own the technical buildout of our AI product suite, including:
Agentic harness: a multi-agent system that safely operates across a business's core tools (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, calendars, email, analytics, compliance systems)
MCP: our MCP that connects Distru to external AI harnesses
Context Layer: our context layer that ingests customer data, builds memories and profiles, and feeds back into our harness to create more personalized AI experiences for our customers
Evals: the eval suites that make our agents reliable in production
And more…
You’ll be working directly on the AI system from the ground up and make strong, opinionated calls on the agentic stack and where it goes next. The AI space moves fast and the specifics will change, so this technical vision is something you'll mold.
You'll report to the VP of Engineering and the Director of AI Engineering, and work closely with the rest of the product team, eng team, and our customers.

Fully remote across 4 continents

18 days PTO + 11 holidays (sick days don't count toward PTO)
Medical, dental, vision + 401(k) for US employees
The best AI tools available and a generous AI stipend for everything else
Yearly in-person team offsites

Recruiter screen (30 min): your background, the most complex AI product you've worked on, and your personal AI tool stack
Technical interview (45-60 min): a deep dive into a complex product you've built, a live harness design discussion, and a screen-share walkthrough of your day-to-day setup
Harness take-home (3-4 hours): spec a real feature on our agentic harness across product and UX, system design, and implementation details
Take-home review (60 min): a technical deep dive into your submission with two engineers, including how your design holds up when a constraint changes

This role serves as a key partner to Product Management, Marketing, and Sales & Distribution teams by analyzing competitor products, identifying market trends, and developing winning sales strategies that help John Hancock increase FIA sales and market share.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in FIA product design, illustrations, indexing strategies, crediting methods, caps, participation rates, spreads, bonuses, riders, and income solutions. Leveraging this expertise, the Competition Analyst will proactively support distribution partners, optimize competitive positioning, and provide actionable insights that help John Hancock win business in the independent marketing organization (IMO) channel.

The role is a remote opportunity open to anyone in the continental US.

Key Accountabilities

• Serve as the subject matter expert for competitive positioning within the FIA marketplace.

• Proactively engage with sales and distribution partners to identify high-potential FIA opportunities and develop customized competitive strategies to improve placement rates.

• Analyze application pipelines, sales trends, and competitive data to identify opportunities to win business from competing carriers.

• Create and deliver competitive FIA illustrations, case design recommendations, and product positioning support for wholesalers and sales teams.

• Monitor competitor product launches, pricing actions, crediting strategy changes, rate adjustments, rider enhancements, and promotional programs.

• Develop competitive intelligence reports and market commentary for leadership, Product Management, and Distribution teams.

• Lead the development of competitive content, sales concepts, comparison materials, and "Competition Corner" resources that clearly articulate John Hancock's value proposition.

• Partner with Product Management throughout product development cycles to ensure competitor insights and market intelligence inform strategic decisions.

• Conduct training sessions for wholesalers, sales desk associates, and distribution partners on FIA product positioning and competitive sales strategies.

• Build and maintain expertise across major FIA competitors, their product portfolios, and their distribution strategies within the IMO marketplace.

Responsibilities

• Provide daily case consultation and illustration support for FIA opportunities.

• Monitor competitive illustration requests and respond with timely recommendations and sales strategies.

• Support internal and external wholesalers with complex FIA case design scenarios.

• Evaluate competitor FIA products including: Crediting strategies, Index allocations, Participation rates, Cap rates, Spread methodologies, Premium bonuses, Income riders, Death benefit riders, Liquidity features, Surrender schedules

• Identify opportunities where John Hancock products can be positioned competitively against specific carriers.

• Present competitive findings and market updates during distribution calls and sales meetings.

• Develop actionable sales concepts that simplify complex FIA product comparisons.

• Collaborate with Marketing to create competitive sales materials and educational content.

• Maintain a deep understanding of regulatory, product, and market developments affecting the FIA industry.

• Support management with ongoing analysis of competitive threats, emerging trends, and distribution opportunities.

Job Requirements

• 3 to 7 years of experience in Fixed Indexed Annuities (FIA) within Product Management, Competitive Intelligence, Competitive Services, Sales Support, Advanced Markets, or Distribution.

• Direct experience supporting IMO distribution channels.

• Demonstrated expertise in FIA product mechanics and competitive positioning.

title: Director of Solution Engineering
description:
About Entegrata

Entegrata helps law firms turn data into decision-grade insights. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Indianapolis, we are a venture-backed SaaS company delivering a turnkey, Azure-based data lakehouse platform purpose-built for law firms. Our platform consolidates siloed legal, operational, and financial data into a single governed source of truth, with AI-powered analytics on top. Our mission is to become the data platform of choice for the top law firms in the world.

The Role

We're hiring a Director of Solution Engineering to be the technical backbone of our sales process, the subject matter expert on the Entegrata platform who guides firms through evaluation, architecture, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Sales throughout the cycle: leading demonstrations, running technical deep dives and infrastructure overviews, and responding to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires. You'll report to our VP of Sales and operate as a senior individual contributor building the solution engineering function from the ground up.

You'll help define how solution engineering works at Entegrata , and lay the groundwork to grow the function as we scale. This is a hands-on role suited to someone with a proven ability to execute who is ready to take the next step into a leadership role, someone who knows what great looks like and is ready for the opportunity to build a function from the ground up.

What You'll Own

•
Product demonstrations. Lead compelling, technically credible demos of the Entegrata platform tailored to each prospect's environment, data landscape, and priorities. Maintain the primary demo environment, to ensure use cases and examples are representative and engaging.

•
Technical deep dives & infrastructure overviews. Lead in-depth technical sessions with prospects' IT, security, and data teams, walking through platform architecture, infrastructure design, and integration approach in the detail needed to move a technical evaluation forward.

•
RFPs & RFIs. Own the technical response to RFPs and RFIs, translating platform capabilities into clear, accurate, compelling answers.

•
Security questionnaires. Partner with our security and engineering teams to complete security questionnaires and support prospects' due diligence and vendor risk reviews.

•
Sales-to-Customer Success handoff. Own a clean, well-documented handoff from sales to implementation, carrying technical context, firm-specific requirements, and open questions forward so nothing is lost in transition.

What You'll Partner On

•
Field sales enablement. Partner directly with the sales team, sitting alongside sales through active evaluations to help prospects navigate their demo requirements, technical questions, security concerns, and evaluation milestones in real time.

•
Customer success & post-sale support. Partner with Customer Success and Implementation Engineering and stay engaged with select customers post-sale where deep platform expertise is needed to support a successful launch.

•
Product & engineering. Work closely with product and engineering to stay abreast of features, functions, limitations and roadmap, while also ensuring prospect feedback and technical requirements make it into the platform development cycle.

•
Function building. Partner with executive and sales leadership to establish the tools, playbooks, and processes for solution engineering at Entegrata as the team grows.

Must-Have Qualifications

•
Sales engineering experience. 5+ years in a sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical pre-sales role, ideally at an enterprise SaaS or data platform company.

•
Modern data platforms. Hands-on experience with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric.

•
Cloud & data architecture. Comfort working across cloud architecture, data pipelines, and integration concepts; Azure experience a plus.

•
Customer-facing communication. Track record of leading technical demos and discussions with both bu

title: Head of Mid Market Sales, North America
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

This is a second line leadership role where you will lead frontline managers, build a world class team, and own the regional Mid Market number for North America. You will be responsible for turning strong early traction into a repeatable, high performing got to market engine across legal and professional services.

We are still early. That means you will operate across altitudes, setting strategy, building structure, and staying close to the field on critical deals. You will help define how Harvey shows up in the North American market, shape our sales motion, and ensure we are delivering real value to customers adopting AI in high stakes competitive environments.

We are looking for someone who has led multi team segments, hired and developed high potential sales managers, scaled teams in ambiguity, implemented a rigorous sales playbook, and knows what great looks like in complex SaaS sales.

About the NAMER Mid-Market Segment

Mid Market at Harvey runs an “enter-lite” motion selling to law firms with 15-150 attorneys, including many of the most prestigious speciality and boutique firms in the world. . Reps own the full cycle, prospecting into net-new accounts, converting them, and driving expansion

You'll inherit a team of Mid Market Sales Managers and their AEs based across western NAMER and will be the primary owner of how that motion runs and scales across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Hire, lead, coach and develop a team of Mid Market Sales Managers across North America driving accountability for net new logo and expansion ARR targets.

- Own and evolve the NAMER Mid-Market playbook end to end- ICP and segmentation criteria, qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), deal stage definitions, discounting and deal desk guardrails, and forecasting cadence, so the motion is repeatable across every manager and AE in the region.

- Implement and maintain a rigorous sales operating cadence, including seller onboarding, enablement, coaching, pipeline generation, and deal execution.

- Drive the regional sales strategy, including territory design, coverage models, and go-to-market execution across the U.S. and Canada.

- Own NAMER mid market forecasting and pipeline health, providing accurate reporting to senior leadership.

- Hire, coach, and retain top managerial talent; build a strong leadership bench across the region.

- Partner with global mid market leadership (EMEA and APAC) to keep the playbook, methodology, and comp/accelerator structure consistent globally while localizing it for NAMER buyer behavior and legal market dynamics.

- Develop executive relationships with Harvey's highest value Mid Market customers across the region.

title: Director of Account Management & Client Success
description:
Director of Account Management & Client Success
Remote | Travel up to 25%

Altus Commercial Receivables is seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Account Management & Client Success to lead and develop a team of Account Managers responsible for client retention, relationship growth, and overall client success. This executive leadership role oversees the Account Management function and is accountable for driving client satisfaction, strengthening executive-level client relationships, supporting revenue growth, and creating a high-performing, client-focused culture.

This position is not responsible for managing collections operations or recovery teams. Instead, the Director will lead a team of client-facing Account Managers who serve as trusted advisors to our clients, ensuring exceptional service delivery, strategic partnership development, and long-term account success.

The successful candidate will be a proven leader with experience building and developing high-performing client service, account management, customer success, or relationship management teams. They will possess strong business acumen, exceptional communication skills, and demonstrated ability to strengthen client relationships, improve retention, and drive business growth.

Working closely with Executive Leadership, Sales, Operations, and key clients, the Director will help shape client strategy, identify opportunities for growth, and ensure the Account Management team consistently delivers value and results.

Travel up to 25% is required to support client relationships, strategic business reviews, team development initiatives, and company objectives.

*This is a remote/telecommute position*

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Account Management Team Leadership

• Lead, coach, develop, and inspire a team of Account Managers responsible for managing and growing client relationships.

• Establish clear performance expectations, accountability standards, and professional development plans.

• Conduct performance evaluations, coaching sessions, training initiatives, and career development activities.

• Foster a culture centered on client success, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Guide Account Managers in building strategic client partnerships and identifying opportunities to enhance client value.

Client Relationship Management

• Oversee the strategic management of client relationships across the organization.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key clients and stakeholders.

• Serve as an escalation point for complex client concerns and ensure timely, effective resolution.

• Lead client business reviews and strategic planning discussions focused on client objectives, performance results, and long-term partnership opportunities.

• Ensure consistent, high-quality client experience across the Account Management team.

Client Retention and Account Growth

• Develop and execute strategies that strengthen client retention, engagement, and long-term partnership success.

• Partner with Account Managers to identify opportunities for account expansion, additional service utilization, and revenue growth.

• Monitor client health indicators and proactively address retention risks.

• Collaborate with Sales and Operations to align service delivery with client expectations and business objectives.

• Champion initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction, loyalty, and account performance.

Strategic Planning and Performance Management

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators related to client retention, account growth, revenue performance, client satisfaction, and team effectiveness.

• Utilize data and analytics to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

• Provide executive leadership with strategic insights and recommendations regarding client relationships, business performance, and growth initiatives.

title: Senior Director, AI Creative Operations
description: At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description The Senior Director for AI Creative Operations (UK/EMEA) will lead the practical evolution of AI-powered creative operations across the region, working across Strategy, Creative, Production, Delivery, Product and Commercial teams to redesign workflows and operating models around the opportunities AI and agentic technology create. This requires a deep understanding of how creative design and production work end to end, from briefing and creative development through to production, adaptation, localisation and delivery. The role will identify where processes can be simplified, automated, connected or reconfigured through Pencil and agentic workflows, while protecting creative quality and commercial effectiveness. Crucially, this is not about imposing a single production model across every client. It is about understanding different client requirements, systems, processes and ways of working, then designing the right combination of people, technology and workflows to deliver effectively within each environment.

We are looking for experienced professionals and subject-matter experts to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project focused on the creation of realistic professional knowledge-based tasks.

• Minimum 3 years of relevant professional work experience in a relevant role in the Human Resources and Organization sector.

• Be located in Mexico.

• Strong practical knowledge of workflows, tools, terminology, standards, and deliverables used in your profession.

• Experience working with multiple documents, data sources, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, or similar professional materials.

• Strong written English (all project-related task creation will be done in English).

• High attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, internally consistent work.

• Ability to distinguish realistic professional work from overly simplified or artificial scenarios.
